items.title: Hervé Blanc
items.summary: Hervé Blanc was a French actor. He was born in Lyon. He was known for his role in the 1980 drama movie A Week's Vacation. He also starred in L'Été ardent (1982), L'émir préfère les blondes (1983), Un fils (2003) and in Ceci est mon corps (2014).
